meta.description: Play free Bible quizzes and test your knowledge of the Old and New Testament. Interactive questions, instant feedback, leaderboards and multiplayer. For young and old!
meta.ogDescription: Test your Bible knowledge with free interactive quizzes. Climb the leaderboard, earn XP and learn more about God's Word. Start now!
meta.twitterDescription: Test your Bible knowledge with free interactive quizzes and climb the leaderboard!

footer.tagline: Test your Bible knowledge with short quizzes.

premiumLock.title: Explanations are Premium
premiumLock.description: Read why each answer is right, with the Bible text alongside.
placeholder: The explanation for this answer tells you what happens in the Bible passage and why this answer is correct.
With Premium you read the explanation and the Bible text for every question, as often as you like.
That way you remember the story better and learn something new in every quiz.

faq.subtitle: Don't see your question? You'll find more answers in the help section.

free.a: You play 3 quizzes for free, without an account. Playing together is always free. If you want all quizzes and the explanation for every answer, you can try Premium free for 7 days.

group.q: How do I start a game for my group?
group.a: Go to Play together, choose Create room and pick a quiz. Share the 6-character code with your group. Up to 20 players join, each on their own phone.

xp.q: How do XP and levels work?
xp.a: You earn XP for every correct answer. With enough XP you go up a level. The leaderboard shows how you are doing, this month and since you started.

translation.q: Which Bible translation do you use?
translation.a: Every answer shows its Bible reference, so you can read the passage yourself.

cancel.a: Via Profile and then Premium. You keep Premium until the end of the period you have already paid for. If you pay through the app, you cancel in the App Store or Google Play.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: In the app via your profile, or via {link}. We erase your profile, your progress and your scores. You cannot undo this afterwards.
deleteAccount.text: In the app via your profile, or via Delete account. We erase your profile, your progress and your scores. You cannot undo this afterwards.

studie.q: Where can I read more about a Bible passage?
studie.a: On {studie}, from the same team. There you read every chapter with an explanation. {about}
studie.text: On Bible Study, from the same team. There you read every chapter with an explanation.

needAccount.a: Not to get started. With an account you keep your XP and your streak. {link} or log in with Google, Apple or your email address.
needAccount.text: Not to get started. With an account you keep your XP and your streak. You can log in with Google, Apple or your email address.

phone.q: Does it work on my phone?
phone.a: Yes. You play in the browser on any device, or in the app for iPhone and Android.

explanation.q: Why can't I see the explanation?
explanation.a: The explanation for each answer is part of {link}. Without Premium you still see the Bible reference for every question, so you can read it yourself.
explanation.text: The explanation for each answer is part of Premium. Without Premium you still see the Bible reference for every question, so you can read it yourself.

mistake.q: I see a mistake in a question. What now?
mistake.a: Report it via {link}. Mention the quiz and the question and we'll look into it.
mistake.text: Report it via Report a problem. Mention the quiz and the question and we'll look into it.

class.q: Can I play with my class or youth group?
class.a: Yes. With play together, up to 20 players join with one code. There is a {link} for churches, schools and youth groups.
class.text: Yes. With play together, up to 20 players join with one code. There is a group license for churches, schools and youth groups.

privacy.q: What do you do with my data?
privacy.a: We use your data to keep track of your account and your progress. We never sell it to third parties. Everything is in the {link}.
privacy.text: We use your data to keep track of your account and your progress. We never sell it to third parties. Everything is in the privacy policy.
